spans.s: दिक्शब्द a word denoting a direction such as पूर्व, उत्तर and the like, used as a substantive, e. g. पूर्वो ग्रामात् , or showing the direction of another thing being its adjective, e. g. इयमस्याः पूर्वा; cf Kas, on
दिक्समास the bahuvrihi compound prescribed by the rule दिङ्नामान्यन्तराले, e.g. पूर्वोत्तरा (north-east) or उत्तरपश्चिमा (north-west): cf. दिक्समासः दिगुपदिष्टः समासः, Kas. on
